title: Safe

source.times: existing source SRT cue-envelope times only; no performer sub-turn timing

method: Human-readable LLM editorial inference from existing in-repository caption-derived reading scaffold and episode/cast metadata; targeted Wikiquote corroboration; no original AVI/audio or repository software invoked.

levels.high: Strong contextual identification or episode-specific printed character attribution, still unverified against original soundtrack
levels.medium: Plausible character inference with at least one meaningful alternative
levels.abstain: Do not assign a named character from the available text

cautions: Every name is an unverified text-only proposal, never independently certified performer identity
Source caption cue boundaries are not confirmed performed turns
Mixed cues list ordered speakers only; exact Unicode source split offsets have NOT been produced or checked
Characters impersonating spiritual entities or Ed Sullivan should retain the distinct persona layer
Unknown voice must not be silently filled by adjacent-scene identity
Do not add this file to the current two-pilot acceptance statistics
